name: 左標誌＋右三欄堆疊連結群組＋回到頂端直向小字
desc: 依內容高度的頁尾，左側標誌、右側數欄由上往下疊放的連結群組，最右側有回到頂端的小按鈕與直向小字，最下方一行小字。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的頁尾，放在頁面最下方，跟著頁面捲動。左右分成兩區，內容對齊頁面內容寬度：左側約四成是品牌區，只放標誌；右側約六成是數欄連結群組，每欄由上往下疊放數組，每組是一個小標題，下方可放直向排列的文字連結，沒有時只留小標題，小標題明顯大於連結。標誌與各欄連結群組的頂端對齊。頁尾右上方、靠近畫面右緣、超出頁面內容寬度處可放一個小型圖示按鈕，按鈕下方有一行旋轉成直向的小字，點擊後回到頁面頂端，沒有時省略。最下方一列是底部列：一行小字靠左，沒有分隔線。
mobile: 左右兩區改為上下排列，全部靠左：連結群組在最上方，標誌在其下，底部列在最下方。連結群組改為收合清單，點小標題後展開該組連結；每個小標題自成一列，列與列之間有分隔線，清單約佔畫面寬的三分之二；沒有下層連結的小標題不展開。回到頂端的小型圖示按鈕移到收合清單右側，直向小字保留。底部列仍是一行小字靠左。

en.name: Left logo + right stacked link-group columns + vertical back-to-top label
en.desc: A content-height footer with a logo on the left, several columns of stacked link groups on the right, a small back-to-top button with a vertical label at the far right, and a line of small text at the bottom.
en.prompt: Create a footer whose height is determined by its content, placed at the very end of the page and scrolling with it. It is split into left and right areas, aligned to the page content width: the left area, about forty percent, is the brand block with only a logo; the right area, about sixty percent, holds multi-column link groups, where each column stacks several groups from top to bottom; each group is a group heading, optionally followed by vertically stacked text links, leaving only the group heading when there are none, and the group heading is clearly larger than the links. The tops of the logo and of every link-group column are aligned. Optionally place a small icon button at the top right of the footer, near the right edge of the viewport and beyond the page content width, with a line of small text rotated to read vertically below it; clicking it returns to the top of the page; omit it when not needed. At the very bottom is the bottom bar: a line of small text aligned left, with no divider.
en.mobile: The left and right areas stack vertically, all left-aligned: the link groups at the top, the logo below them, and the bottom bar at the very bottom. The link groups become an accordion, where tapping a group heading expands that group's links; each group heading forms its own row, with dividers between rows, and the list takes about two thirds of the viewport width; group headings without links do not expand. The small back-to-top icon button moves to the right of the accordion, keeping its vertical text. The bottom bar remains a line of small text aligned left.
